text:
```yaml
name: Prompt Test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup-sentry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Initialize Sentry
        run: |
          echo "SENTRY_DSN=your_sentry_dsn_here" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SENTRY_ORG=your_sentry_org_here" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SENTRY_PROJECT=your_sentry_project_here" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run test task
        run: npm run test:sentry
```

Please replace `your_sentry_dsn_here`, `your_sentry_org_here`, and `your_sentry_project_here` with actual values from your Sentry project. Also, ensure that the `test:sentry` script is correctly configured in your `package.json` to throw an error for testing purposes.
